Use this information to enhance the draft:
Default role is 'Applicant & Respondent', use if not specify.

The orders sought can be so many. Hence it should begin with, 'AN ORDER..', 'A DECLARATION' etc.

Always complete this 'counsel to the ___'. it is always the Applicant. so it could be Claimant/Applicant, Defendant/Applicant, Applicant.

The Title of this template can be modified to something related to the instructions. eg MOTION ON NOTICE FOR ..., etc

If no {{grounds}} is provided, remove the entire block, including the sectionTitle.

 
if there is a party three, include it like this eg BETWEEN Jackson(Applicant) and John(Defendant) and johnson(party sought to be joined).

Party Three: {{partyThree}} {{partThreeRole}}.
